description_en: Queries a list of custom transcoding template groups for the MediaConvert (MC) pipeline by using paging
description_zh: 调用本接口分页查询MediaConvert（MC）链路自定义转码模板组列表
name: ListMediaConvertTemplateGroup

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Default value: 30. Valid values: 1 to 200
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的最大条数。默认值：30。取值：1~200
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first call. The value is a string in the format of page_N, where N is the page number. You can pass the NextToken value returned in the previous response to obtain the next page. If the response does not return NextToken, all data has been read
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标。首次调用时无需传入。取值为形如page_N（N为页码）的字符串；传入上一次响应返回的NextToken可获取下一页；响应未返回NextToken表示数据已读取完毕
parameters.name: next_token

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned in the current request

NextToken.description_en: The pagination cursor for the next page, in the format of page_N. If this parameter is not returned, all data has been read
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页分页游标，形如page_N。未返回时表示数据已读取完毕

TemplateGroupList.description_en: The list of transcoding template groups

AppId.description_en: The application ID. Default value: app-1000000. For more information, see [Multiple applications]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html）
AppId.description_zh: 应用ID。默认取值： app-1000000。使用说明，请参见[多应用]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html）

CreationTime.description_en: The creation time. The time is displayed in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format

ModifyTime.description_en: The modification time. The time is displayed in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format

Name.description_en: The name of the transcoding template group

TemplateType.description_en: The type of the template group. Valid values: Normal: normal transcoding template group; VideoPackage: video packaging template group
TemplateType.description_zh: 模板组类型。取值：Normal：普通转码模板组；VideoPackage：视频打包模板组

TranscodeTemplateGroupId.description_en: The ID of the transcoding template group

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of transcoding template groups that meet the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合条件的转码模板组总条数
